items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua left practice early Thursday due to a calf injury and was listed as limited. Comes after Davante Adams (hamstring rupture) already out 6-10 weeks.
items.why: Left practice early; listed limited on report.
items.implication: Major target hog at risk for Week 7 vs LV; monitor Friday report closely for OUT/GTD.
items.opportunity: If out or limited, elevated routes/targets for remaining Rams WRs/TEs (Higbee etc.).

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially did not practice for a second straight day due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Rising OUT risk for Week 7; monitor final report.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Xavier Worthy and other KC pass-catchers if inactive.

items.text: Multiple teams open to potential trade for Colts RB Jonathan Taylor; unclear if Colts ready to deal before deadline.
items.why: Source to ESPN confirms multi-team interest.
items.implication: ROS landing spot uncertainty; hold pending deadline clarity.
items.opportunity: If traded to contender, role/volume upgrade possible.

items.text: Saquon Barkley is back/in line to play Week 7 vs DAL (MNF). Efficient in prior full games; Dallas strong fantasy RB matchup. Berry ranks ~RB15.
items.why: Expected to practice/play per reports; Berry viewing positively on return.
items.implication: Immediate RB2/flex with upside in good matchup; monitor snaps post-hamstring.
items.opportunity: Lead carries/routes/goal-line if full go; reverse prior backups.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) back to practice Thursday (first since Week 3 injury), per team injury report.
items.why: Upgraded to practice after missing time.
items.implication: Chance to play vs MIA; final status pending Friday/Saturday.
items.opportunity: If active, reclaims lead role/snaps/carries; reverse prior handcuff elevation.

items.text: Seahawks activated RB Zach Charbonnet from PUP list; significant step in ACL recovery (full participant recently).
items.why: Activated from PUP; full practice progress noted.
items.implication: Imminent return candidate; impacts SEA RB depth/snaps immediately or soon.
items.opportunity: Competes for carries; squeezes Jadarian Price/others on depth chart.

items.text: Josh Jacobs allowed in Packers facility for meetings, lifting, medical/non-football activities. Backups MarShawn Lloyd (49th EPA/rush) and Kaleb Johnson (53rd) have been poor (OL issues too).
items.why: Facility access + poor backup EPA data from ROS Top-150 show.
items.implication: Jacobs long-term outlook improved; less concern on extended absence.
items.opportunity: Reclaims lead RB snaps/carries/goal-line on return; fade Lloyd/Johnson.

items.text: Lamar Jackson present for start of Thursday practice (after limited/absent earlier in week); growing optimism for return.
items.why: On field Thursday after prior absences/limping.
items.implication: Trending toward possible Week 7 return vs CIN; monitor designation.
items.opportunity: Full offense unlock if active; Huntley fades.

items.text: With Davante Adams out and Terrance Ferguson recovery delayed (not ready off IR soon), Rams' answer is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game.
items.why: Ferguson not expected ready; Adams long-term out leaves Puka as primary.
items.implication: Elite WR1 volume ROS if healthy.
items.opportunity: Massive target/route share spike; red-zone/two-minute hog.
items.conflict: New calf injury creates immediate risk to this projection.

items.text: LOVE A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10). Back in real role with high target share/routes; Bears secondary allows yardage.
items.why: Usage rebound + favorable Bears matchup for pass catchers.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; buy low on recent inefficiency.

items.text: LOVE DeVonta Smith vs DAL (WR11). Elite volume continues; strong matchup.
items.opportunity: High target/route share in Eagles offense.

items.text: HATE Josh Jacobs @ DET (RB18). Workload questions after long layoff.
items.why: Layoff workload uncertainty vs tough spot.
items.conflict: Conflicts with Levitan facility/backup-poor data suggesting positive ROS.

items.text: Thorman Snaps & Pace Week 7: Up in pace TB@CAR; high volume GB@DET, LAR@LV. Slow slogs MIA@NYJ (and others). Free notes on opportunity/pace.
items.why: Neutral pace/PROE/snaps data; TB/CAR rising, MIA/NYJ low volume.
items.implication: Prioritize players in high-pace/high-total games (GB-DET, LAR-LV, TB-CAR); avoid slogs for volume.
items.opportunity: Elevated snap/play opportunities in up-pace spots for skill players.

items.text: JJ McCarthy YPT when targeting Justin Jefferson only 5.7 (vs Mullens 10.8, Cousins 10.5, Darnold 10.0, Wentz 9.9). Different scheme/coaches/small sample but hard to ignore; Giants plan to start McCarthy.
items.why: Low historical YPT efficiency with McCarthy.
items.implication: Efficiency/ceiling concern for Jefferson if McCarthy under center.
items.conflict: Room for improvement noted; scheme change.
